query: 循环经济策略 循环经济策略 衡量企业在减量化、再利用、再制造、闭环管理方面的体系。 内容质量得分 (取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备完善的循环经济战略与路线图，在产品设计阶段引入生态设计（Eco-design），有跨供应链的协同回收机制，并建立了量化目标与治理闭环。 • 1分（合格）：有基础的减废或资源利用方向描述，具备部分再利用项目案例，但缺乏顶层战略、量化目标或系统性的供应链协同。 • 0分（不合格）：无循环经济相关披露，或仅有笼统的“节约资源”表述。 循环经济 循环经济路线图 生态设计 可拆解设计 可维修设计 可回收设计 再生材料 循环材料 再制造 工业共生 闭环回收 生产者责任延伸 以旧换新 产品回收计划 circular economy circular economy roadmap eco-design design for disassembly design for repair design for recyclability recycled content circular materials remanufacturing industrial symbiosis closed-loop recycling extended producer responsibility take-back programme 企业是否披露循环经济战略或路线图？ 是否在产品设计阶段引入生态设计？ 有哪些再利用、再制造或闭环回收机制？ 是否建立跨供应链协同回收？ 是否有量化目标与治理闭环？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '循环经济策略'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否披露循环经济战略或路线图？ 是否在产品设计阶段引入生态设计？ 有哪些再利用、再制造或闭环回收机制？ 是否建立跨供应链协同回收？ 是否有量化目标与治理闭环？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“节约资源”；仅有一般废弃物合规处置；仅有植树或公益回收日；仅有用水回用但无产品/物料循环体系；区分：循环经济策略强调减量化再利用再制造与闭环体系；产品回收率是更窄的量化绩效；节水回用只是水资源效率，不能单独代表完整循环经济策略。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: During the Reporting Period, with the support and cooperation of the energy working group, all departments of the Compal Production Plant have mobilised employees at all levels to participate in discussions on production energy use analysis. Starting from various aspects that affect energy consumption, such as personnel, machinery and equipment, material use, and process methods, and combining the process flow of production operations and the Company's 'Energy and Resource Management Procedure', these departments have conducted a comprehensive analysis of the energy utilisation and consumption data and equipment operation records for the year 2021. Besides, the Compal Production Plant has sorted out the energy use of the plants and strengthened the energy consumption management of all plants in accordance with the energy efficiency limit standards of various types of equipment, the economic operation standards of various types of equipment, the design parameters of various types of energy-consuming equipment, and the advanced energy consumption level of the industry, etc.

[Content]
During the Reporting Period, both the Compal Production Plant and the Neijiang Production Plant adopted the residual heat recovery unit of air compressor to heat domestic water and reduce the consumption of electricity and energy. The residual heat recovery of the Compal Production Plant was 745.89 million kcal replacing 455,600 m 3 of natural gas and 553 tons of coal equivalent; the Neijiang Production Plant saved 300,000 m 3 of natural gas and reduced 369 tons of coal equivalent for the whole year.

results.text: Ju Teng International always encourages each Production Plant to fully utilise its own advantages and resources to develop and build new energy projects such as photovoltaic power generation.
